experiment_name: MonopolyZero strength pilot: 32-game ASU-import-free training (CPU, seed 42)

algorithm_config.opponent_mix: 16 self-play games (model controls all 4 seats) + 16 vs-fixed games (model rotates seats 0-3, 4 times each; fixed-a/b/c fill the other 3 seats)
algorithm_config.optimizer_source: monopoly_bench.config.TrainingConfig defaults (learning_rate/weight_decay/gradient_clip fields only, read directly from the dataclass)
algorithm_config.batch_size_and_updates_source: this project's own pilot-scale choice, not TrainingConfig's frozen-v1 defaults (batch_size=256, updates_per_generation=1000, sized for 32-games-per-generation at full scale, not a one-shot 32-game pilot)
algorithm_config.seed_note: seeds=[42, 0]: 42 is GLOBAL_SEED (Python/NumPy/torch RNG seeding + replay-sample RNG); 0 is unused here (reserved for eval's greedy-decoding seed, listed for completeness, not consumed by this script)

result: Training succeeded end to end: 32/32 games completed (0 illegal actions, 0 crashes), 37,772 positions collected, all 100 training updates produced finite losses, both checkpoints (pre-training baseline and post-training trained) saved and hashed. asu_modules_loaded was [] (count 0) at the end of the run, confirmed by the script's own sys.modules guard. Fixed-agent fallbacks: 11 total, all from TheDealMaker in a single vs-fixed game (seed 20013) - not a crash, the compatibility-fallback path working as designed. This is a training-plumbing-at-scale result; whether it produced a measurably different/stronger policy is evaluated separately in 014-monopolyzero-strength-pilot-paired-eval.json, not claimed here.
notes: Checkpoints (artifacts/monopolyzero_strength_pilot/{baseline_pretraining,trained_32games}.pt) are NOT committed, per CLAUDE.md - referenced here by SHA-256 and local path only. Per-game breakdown (32 entries: category, seed, focus_seat, decisions, winner, positions, fallbacks) is in the raw stdout log, not duplicated here.
